deathrestart.reconnect.waiting: The host is generating a new world. Reconnecting soon…

deathrestart.config.title: Death Restart Settings
deathrestart.config.scope: Host settings apply to all players. Guests can adjust local reconnect only. Configure your next session from the main menu.
deathrestart.config.reset_countdown.tool: Host setting: Duration used for the next death countdown. Ongoing countdowns are not affected.
deathrestart.config.manual_restart_confi: Host setting: Enabled by default. Manual restarts require /deathrestart restart confirm within 60 seconds. When disabled, the countdown starts immediately. Existing requests and countdowns are unchanged. Deaths still trigger automatic resets.
deathrestart.config.clear_leaderboard.to: Only available to the host while a world is open. Clears both player-name and UUID death statistics for this save. Online players start again at 0. Other saves are unaffected.
deathrestart.config.clear_leaderboard.co: Clear this save's death leaderboard? Both player-name and UUID statistics will be cleared. Online players start again at 0. This cannot be undone.
deathrestart.config.countdown_start_soun: Host setting: Plays an alert sound for all online players when the countdown begins.
deathrestart.config.countdown_final_seco: Host setting: Plays a tick sound every second during the final 3 seconds.
Guest setting: Automatically reconnects to the host address after a world reset. Takes effect on the next reset.
deathrestart.config.reconnect_interval.t: Guest setting: Initial delay and minimum interval between reconnect attempts. Ongoing connections will not retry concurrently.
deathrestart.config.reconnect_timeout.to: Guest setting: Maximum time to wait before timing out. Rejoin manually from the multiplayer menu if expired.
deathrestart.config.death_leaderboard.to: Host setting: When disabled, hides the death leaderboard for all players. Death totals will still accumulate in the background.
deathrestart.config.statistics_mode.tool: Host setting: Player Name mode is case-insensitive and merges identical names. UUID mode tracks by account across name changes. Stored separately; switching will not merge data.
deathrestart.config.backup_retention.too: Host setting: Automatically deletes older standard backups after a new world starts. Failed-world and unfinished-reset backups are never deleted automatically. Defaults to unlimited.
deathrestart.config.backup_port_note: Every reset preserves the old world backup and reuses the original LAN port.
deathrestart.config.save_failed_details: Cannot write to config/deathrestart.json. Changes were not applied. Please verify folder write permissions and retry.
deathrestart.command.not_lan: Please open the world to LAN before using reset commands.
deathrestart.command.invalid_countdown: Countdown must be one of: 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 45, or 60 seconds.
deathrestart.command.save_failed: Failed to save settings; no changes were applied.
deathrestart.command.restart_broadcast: The host initiated a manual reset. The world will reset in %s seconds.
deathrestart.command.restart_confirmatio: Manual reset prepared. Confirming will start a %s-second countdown. Run /deathrestart restart confirm within 60 seconds.
There is no valid manual reset request. Run /deathrestart restart [seconds] again.
A manual reset is already awaiting confirmation. Run /deathrestart restart confirm or /deathrestart cancel first.
deathrestart.command.already_scheduled: A world reset is already counting down: %s seconds remaining.
deathrestart.command.reset_started: World reset has already started and cannot be cancelled.
deathrestart.command.cancelled: The host cancelled the world reset.
deathrestart.command.no_countdown: There is no pending world reset.
deathrestart.command.status_idle: No world reset is currently scheduled.
deathrestart.command.status_confirmation: Awaiting manual reset confirmation (%s-second countdown after confirmation).
deathrestart.command.status_details: Identity Mode: %s · Leaderboard: %s · Port: %s · Account Authentication: %s
deathrestart.command.leaderboard_enabled: Death leaderboard is now visible to everyone. Deaths will continue to be counted.
deathrestart.command.leaderboard_disable: Death leaderboard is now hidden from everyone. Deaths will continue to be counted.
deathrestart.command.leaderboard.clear_p: This will clear both player-name and UUID death statistics for this save. This cannot be undone. Run /deathrestart leaderboard clear confirm within 60 seconds.
deathrestart.command.leaderboard.clear_e: No valid leaderboard clear request. Run /deathrestart leaderboard clear again.
deathrestart.command.leaderboard.cleared: Player-name and UUID death statistics for this save have been cleared. Online players start again at 0.
deathrestart.command.leaderboard.clear_f: Could not clear the leaderboard. Statistics were not cleared. Check the statistics file and game folder write permissions. See the game logs for details.
deathrestart.command.countdown_updated: Default reset countdown updated to %s seconds. Takes effect on the next death.
deathrestart.recovery.title: Interrupted Reset Recovery
deathrestart.recovery.restored: Restored %s interrupted world(s). Reopen the original save to continue; unfinished world data is preserved in failed-* folders.
deathrestart.recovery.failures: Failed to recover %s transaction(s). Files were preserved. Check game logs and backup folder: %s
deathrestart.recovery.commit_failed: Failed to save the reset completion record. Backups are preserved; the mod will retry automatically. Check the game logs.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.deathrest: In LAN multiplayer, any player's death triggers a countdown, automatically rebuilding the world with a new seed while reusing the same LAN port. Features cumulative death leaderboards, auto-reconnect, and configurable timers.
